engine

What is inside every page

Features a bakery actually asks for, written without a framework so the file stays editable for the next ten years.

4 languages out of the box

English, French, Spanish and Arabic dictionaries, 100% key parity, validated at build time.

True right-to-left

One attribute flips the whole layout: logical CSS properties, mirrored icons, Arabic numerals and Arabic plural rules.

Pre-order basket

Add, edit quantities, remember it in localStorage, hand the order over by WhatsApp or email. Nothing charged, nothing to maintain.

Live oven countdown

“Next bake in 42 min” computed from the bake log, updated every second, honest about sold-out batches.

Open-now logic

Header badge and hours table read your schedule, your timezone and today's holiday, not a hard-coded string.

Responsive to 320 px

Fluid type with clamp(), touch targets ≥ 44 px, container queries on cards, print sheet for the till.

Accessible by default

Keyboard paths, focus rings, aria-live on basket updates, 4.5:1 contrast, reduced-motion honoured.

Fast and offline-friendly

Zero dependencies, ~38 KB of script, system fonts, preloaded hero, works from a file:// folder if you must.

i18n · RTL

One click, whole site

Every string, date, number, currency and direction is driven by the dictionary below. The choice is remembered per visitor.

Numbers and currency are formatted with the browser's Intl API: €2.40 becomes 2,40 € in French, 2,40 € in Spanish and ‏٢٫٤٠ € when Arabic is requested with Arabic numerals.

en · en-GB Fresh butter croissant — €2.40 — out of the oven at 06:30English · LTR · €2.40
fr · fr-FR Croissant au beurre frais — 2,40 € — sortie du four à 6 h 30Français · LTR · 2,40 €
es · es-ES Croissant de mantequilla recién hecho — 2,40 € — del horno a las 6:30Español · LTR · 2,40 €
ar · ar-EB كرواسون بالزبدة طازة — ٢,٤٠ € — يطلع من الفرن ٦:٣٠العربية · RTL · ‏2.40 €

    docs

    Run it, brand it, ship it

    Four commands between a clone and a client's domain. Everything is plain HTML, CSS and ESM JavaScript.

    # 1 — clone & preview
git clone https://github.com/abdoo606/BLAblalba.git cd BLAblalba
npm run dev              # http://localhost:5173

# 2 — make it the client's shop
nano src/data/site.json          # prices, hours, batches
nano src/data/locales/fr.json     # copy & translate
nano src/styles/core.css          # colours, type scale

# 3 — build & ship
npm run build            # → dist/ (static, 4 pages)
npm run package          # → release/levain-kit.zip
gh api /repos/x/pages  # or drop dist/ on any host

    Clone

    Install nothing. The kit has no dependencies at all.

    Change content

    Edit src/data/site.json for prices, hours and products; edit src/data/locales/*.json for words.

    Build

    The generator rebuilds three static templates and inlines the dictionaries.

    Deploy

    Any static host. Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare, a USB stick — it all works.

    QA checklist

    Things to try right now

    Open any template and poke it: these interactions are wired and working in the demo.

    1. Add three croissants to the basket, reload the page — it is still there.
    2. Switch to العربية and watch the layout mirror, prices and dates re-format.
    3. Watch the “next bake” countdown tick down to zero and flip to “just out of the oven”.
    4. Type “cake” in the menu search and see the filter, count and empty state react.
    5. Submit the pre-order form with empty fields to see the inline validation.
    6. Resize to 320 px, or zoom to 200%, and check nothing breaks.
